title: A/B Test Analysis — Old vs New Page
description: Analyze an A/B test: conversion rates, z-test, confidence interval, ship decision.
overview_content:
Lab intro

Experimentation Basics Track: Rates, Z-Test, Ship/No-Ship

Scenario: ab_test.csv logs 294,478 sessions with con_treat (control/treatment), page, converted (0/1). Compute conversion rates, a two-proportion z-test, a 95% CI, and a minimum detectable effect — then conclude whether to ship. You will learn: group-by rates, standard error, z-test (manual or scipy), power sketch, peeking pitfall. Time: ~50 minutes. Level: Intermediate. Needs: pandas + math/scipy. Env: 🟢 Colab only.
steps_content:
Exercises (do these!)

Exercise 1 — Conversion by group

Print conversions, n, and rate for control and treatment (6 d.p.). Expected: control 17723/147202 = 0.120399 · treatment 17514/147276 = 0.118920.

Follow-up: Express the lift relative to control. Check: about minus 1.23 percent.

Hint

df.groupby("con_treat")["converted"].agg(["sum","count","mean"]).

Exercise 2 — Z-test + p-value

Run the two-proportion z-test. Report z (4 d.p.) and p (4 d.p.). Significant at α=0.05? Expected: z ≈ −1.2369, p ≈ 0.2161 → not significant.

Follow-up: Confirm the observed diff lies inside the 95 percent CI. Check: minus 0.003824 < diff < 0.000865.

Hint

Pool proportions for SE under H₀; two-sided p via 2*(1-Φ(|z|)).

Exercise 3 — MDE at 80% power

Using the pooled SE from the null, compute MDE = (1.96+0.84)·SE. Report absolute and % of control rate. Expected: ≈ 0.00335 absolute ≈ 2.78% of 0.1204.

Follow-up: Is the observed effect even detectable — compare its size to the MDE. Check: no, the test is underpowered for this effect.

Hint

mde = (1.96 + 0.84) * se_pool; relative = mde / p0.
